functions: Division 7A minimum yearly repayment from the unpaid balance, benchmark rate and remaining term

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  Div7AMinRepaymentλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Minimum yearly repayment of a Division 7A amalgamated loan under ITAA 1936 s 109E(6), unrounded*/
/*  SOURCE:         Income Tax Assessment Act 1936, compilation 193 (1 October 2026), read 22 November 2026:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C1936A00027/2026-10-01/2026-10-01/text/original/epub/OEBPS/document_2/document_2.html
                    s 109E(5) and (6): the minimum yearly repayment of an amalgamated loan is the amount of
                    the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income times the current year's
                    benchmark interest rate, divided by 1 less (1 / (1 + that rate)) to the power of the
                    remaining term, which is rounded up to the next whole number of years. s 109N(2): the
                    benchmark rate is the Reserve Bank's Indicator Lending Rates bank variable housing loan
                    rate last published before the year starts. s 109N(3): the maximum term is 25 years
                    for a loan secured by a registered mortgage over real property, otherwise 7 years.
                    Income Tax Assessment (1936 Act) Regulation 2015, compilation 8 (9 December 2022), read
                    22 November 2026, provides no other way of working out either amount.
                    ATO, 'Division 7A - benchmark interest rate', last updated 1 July 2026, read 22 November
                    2026: 8.77% for the income year ending 30 June 2027, 8.37% for 2026, 8.77% for 2025:
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/division-7a-benchmark-interest-rate
                    ATO, 'Loans by private companies', last updated 2 July 2026, read 22 November 2026,
                    works $55,000 at 5.95% over 7 years to $9,835 and $50,430 at 5.45% over 6 years to
                    $10,079, each rounded to the dollar:
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/corporate-tax-measures-and-assurance/private-company-benefits-division-7a-dividends/in-detail/division-7a-loans
*/
Div7AMinRepaymentλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [OpeningBalance],
    [BenchmarkRate],
    [RemainingTerm],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →Div7AMinRepaymentλ(OpeningBalance, BenchmarkRate, RemainingTerm)¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Division 7A minimum yearly repayment of an amalgamated loan, ITAA 1936 s 109E(6).¶NOTES!         →The minimum yearly repayment of a Division 7A amalgamated loan under ITAA¶               →1936 s 109E(6): the balance not repaid by the end of the previous income¶               →year, at the current year's benchmark interest rate, over the remaining¶               →term rounded up to whole years. It equals PMT(BenchmarkRate, remaining¶               →term, -OpeningBalance). The rate is supplied: the ATO publishes it for each¶               →income year ending 30 June (8.77% for 2026-27), and a company with a¶               →substituted accounting period works out its own. The result is not rounded.¶               →Arithmetic only: it does not decide whether a loan complies with s 109N,¶               →which payments count as repayments (s 109R), or whether a shortfall is a¶               →dividend; there is no minimum yearly repayment in the year the loan is¶               →made.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit/blob/main/docs/australian-modelling.md¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →22 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "OpeningBalance →(Required) One or more balances not repaid by the end of the previous income year, each 0 or more and under 10,000,000,000,000. A blank stays blank.¶" &
                            "BenchmarkRate  →(Required) The current year's benchmark interest rate, such as 8.77% for 2026-27.¶" &
                            "RemainingTerm  →(Required) Years left of the longest constituent loan's term, more than 0 and at most 25 (7 unless the loan is secured as s 109N(3)(a) requires): one for every balance, or one for each. A part year is rounded up.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.Div7AMinRepaymentλ({100000;60000}, 8.77%, {5;6})¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→25556.00¶" &
                            "→13283.60",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR( ISOMITTED( OpeningBalance), ISOMITTED( BenchmarkRate), ISOMITTED( RemainingTerm)),
    //  One rate for the year, as a fraction; an error passes so it shows
        ValidRate?,     IFERROR( IF( ROWS( BenchmarkRate) * COLUMNS( BenchmarkRate) = 1, IF( ISERROR( BenchmarkRate), TRUE, AND( ISNUMBER( BenchmarkRate), BenchmarkRate > 0, BenchmarkRate < 1)), FALSE), ISERROR( BenchmarkRate)),
        RateMessage,    "BenchmarkRate must be one rate above 0 and below 1, such as 8.77% or 0.0877.",
    //  One term for every loan, or one for each in the same shape
        OneTerm?,       AND( ROWS( RemainingTerm) = 1, COLUMNS( RemainingTerm) = 1),
        ValidShape?,    OR( OneTerm?, AND( ROWS( RemainingTerm) = ROWS( OpeningBalance), COLUMNS( RemainingTerm) = COLUMNS( OpeningBalance))),
        ShapeMessage,   "RemainingTerm must be one term, or a term for each opening balance in the same shape.",
    //  A blank is nil and stays blank; an error passes so it shows
        ValidBalance?,  AND( IF( ISERROR( OpeningBalance), TRUE, IF( ISNUMBER( OpeningBalance), ( OpeningBalance >= 0) * ( OpeningBalance < 1E13), OpeningBalance & "" = ""))),
        BalanceMessage, "Div7AMinRepaymentλ needs each opening balance to be a number from 0 to under 10,000,000,000,000, or blank.",
        Terms,          IF( OneTerm?, IF( SEQUENCE( ROWS( OpeningBalance), COLUMNS( OpeningBalance)), RemainingTerm), RemainingTerm),
    //  A term is needed only beside a balance; an error passes so it shows
        ValidTerm?,     IFERROR( AND( IF( ISERROR( OpeningBalance), TRUE, IF( OpeningBalance & "" = "", TRUE, IF( ISERROR( Terms), TRUE, IF( ISNUMBER( Terms), ( Terms > 0) * ( Terms <= 25), FALSE))))), FALSE),
        TermMessage,    "RemainingTerm must be more than 0 and at most 25 years for each opening balance.",
    //  Procedure - s 109E(6), the remaining term rounded up to whole years
        Result,         MAP( OpeningBalance, Terms, LAMBDA( Balance, Term,
                            IF( Balance & "" = "", "", PMT( BenchmarkRate, ROUNDUP( Term, 0), -Balance))
                        )),
    //  Return Result, Help, or the message
        Return,         IF( Help?, 2, IF( NOT( ValidRate?), 3, IF( NOT( ValidShape?), 4, IF( NOT( ValidBalance?), 5, IF( NOT( ValidTerm?), 6, 1))))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, RateMessage, ShapeMessage, BalanceMessage, TermMessage)
    )
);

Financial: "IncomeTaxλ         →Tax on taxable income at the general rates, 2024-25 to 2026-27, before the Medicare levy and offsets¶"
